environment.description: EKS cluster running the Actix-web proxy service with IAM Roles for Service Accounts (IRSA). The service account has an IAM role (arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/grpc-proxy-role) with AdministratorAccess policy attached. Downstream services trust gRPC metadata for session context propagation. No header sanitization at the ingress layer. Envoy sidecar passes all metadata keys without filtering.
